info.name: Vast (Informational - No Public API)
info.description: Vast (vastspace.com) is a commercial space-station company. It publishes no public developer API, so this collection contains no executable API requests - only links to informational product and research surfaces. Not to be confused with Vast.ai (GPU cloud) or VAST Data (storage).
